KeyEvidence: After the 17 zero-commit months (2019-02 through 2020-06), Dependabot bumps log4j-core on 2020-07-01 and junit on 2020-10-13. treibi adds cross/yield files and a link to Schelp's code on 2020-10-22, and Arne Kesting merges PRs #55 and #57 on 2020-11-03. Volume stays low (7 commits in 2020, 15 in 2021) but never returns to a gap that long, and commits continue into 2024-2025. Source: tgarrio1_project_gap_commits.csv and monthly series.

The only zero-commit month is 2022-02. Benjamin Nachman's weekly update resumes on 2022-03-06, and new contributors (nmallick 2022-04-21, Congqiao Li 2022-05-06, Leigh Whitehead 2022-05-13) follow. Every later month through 2025-11 except 2023-04, 2024-03 and 2025-09 has commits. Source: tgarrio1_project_gap_commits.csv and monthly series.

After the 2013-10 through 2014-01 gap, Dahua Lin recompiles vadd.cu on 2014-02-08, Kashif Rasul adds missing error descriptors (merged as PR #4 on 2014-03-26), and Pieter Verstraete adds CUDA API-version support the same week. 14,305 commits follow. Source: tgarrio1_project_gap_commits.csv and monthly series.

Recovery is real but maintenance-level. Most WoC post-gap rows are 'Merge <sha> into bf3f427...' pull-request refs rather than default-branch commits. On upstream master the GCC 13 build fix bf3f427 (authored 2023-08-13, before the gap) is merged on 2024-11-08 and 43095e4 fixes the Toolkit databases URL on 2025-08-12. Substantive development (607f826, 1f8d8c4 and others) only resumes in 2026, after the cutoff. Source: gap commits and upstream default-branch git history.

After the 2024-03 through 2024-10 gap, John Blischak defines the Codecov token on 2024-11-22 and migrates CI runners to Ubuntu 24 on 2024-12-13. Work continues with the testthat 3rd-edition migration (2025-04-30), Eric Weine's GitLab default-branch change (2025-06-09) and the 1.7.2 version bump (0438b40, 2025-08-01). Source: tgarrio1_project_gap_commits.csv and upstream default-branch git history.

After the 2019-03 through 2019-10 gap, Oscar Barragan updates the makefile on 2019-11-15 and fixes a bad push on 2019-11-20, then adds single-transit routines on 2020-05-25 and a new code version on 2021-07-26. The official isl-org/MiDaS master ends at 4545977 (merge of the SECURITY.md PR #274) on 2024-08-23 with no later commits, and GitHub shows the repository was archived by the owner on 2025-08-25. The WoC post-gap rows (BlancJH and ky747, 2025-07-28 through 2025-08-21) are fork commits or 'Merge <sha> into 4545977...' PR refs. Upstream has 88 commits versus 200 in WoC. Source: upstream default-branch git history, GitHub repository page and tgarrio1_project_gap_commits.csv.

The WoC monthly series (2020-03 through 2024-04) has no zero-commit month, so there is no longest gap to recover from. Upstream, the automated dataset commits stop on 2024-07-21, three wind-down commits follow in 2025-01 (including 'Close Registration' #1410), and the README (Feb 2026) marks the project archived and winding down. That is shutdown, not recovery. N/A is an exception to the binary codebook. Source: tgarrio1_commits_timeseries_covid-projections_covid-data-model.csv and upstream default-branch git history.

Martino Pilia's GCC 8.1 build fix follows on 2018-06-01, and 1,966 commits come after the gap, with 2023-2024 the busiest years. Source: tgarrio1_project_gap_commits.csv and monthly series.

ValidatorValue: Automated Dependabot dependency bumps (log4j-core, then junit) restarted activity, after which the maintainers merged those PRs and added contributed road-scenario files.

AuthorValue: Weekly literature updates resumed on March 6, 2022, followed by new paper references and pre-commit bot updates.
